**ON THE UNIFICATION OF QUANTUM 3–MANIFOLD INVARIANTS**

*ANNA BELIAKOVA AND THANG LE*

18 pp, 20 sections.

**Abstract.** In 2006 Habiro initiated a construction of generating functions for Witten– Reshetikhin–Turaev (WRT) invariants known as uniﬁed WRT invariant s. In a series of papers together with Irmgard B¨ uhler and Christian Blanchet we ex tended his construc- tion to a larger class of 3–manifolds. The uniﬁed invariants provide a s trong tool to study properties of the whole collection of WRT invariants, e.g. their integrality, and hence, their categoriﬁcation. In this paper we give a survey on ideas and techniques used in the con struction of the uniﬁed invariants.

**Outline.** Introduction; Background; 1.3 Kirby moves; 1 Quantum (WRT) invariants; 1.1 Notations and conventions; 1.2 The colored Jones polynomial; 1.4 Evaluation and Gauss sums; 2 Main Results; 2.2 Laplace transform; 2.1 Strategy of the proof; 2.4 Diagonalization using lens spaces; 3 Cyclotomic completions of polynomial rings; 3.1 On cyclotomic polynomials; 3.3 Taylor expansion; 3.4 Splitting of Sp and evaluation; 3.5 On the Ohtsuki series at roots of unity; 4 Laplace transform, Andrews identity and Frob; 4.3 Frobenius isomorphism
